C0854.title: RaaS Becomes Dominant Framework for Ransomware Attacks
C0854.summary: FreeBuf reported on May 8, 2025 that Ransomware-as-a-Service (RaaS) had become a major business model for cybercriminals seeking profit through digital extortion. RaaS operators provide affiliates with customizable ransomware payloads, infrastructure, payment processing, and technical support, usually in exchange for a 20%-30% share of proceeds. Groups such as Conti, REvil, and LockBit have built relatively mature operating structures.
